Parallel condition:
\[
\frac{1}{2}=\frac{-2}{n}\Rightarrow n=-4.
\]
Rewrite \(l_1\) with same coefficients as \(l_2\):
\[
l_1:\ 2x-4y+2m=0,\qquad l_2:\ 2x-4y-6=0.
\]
Distance:
\[
\frac{|2m+6|}{\sqrt{2^2+(-4)^2}}=2\sqrt5
\]
\[
\frac{2m+6}{2\sqrt5}=2\sqrt5 \Rightarrow 2m+6=20 \Rightarrow m=7.
\]
Thus
\[
m+n=7-4=3.
\]
\[
\boxed{3}
\]
